gaps.sentence: The album went straight ___ number one in the charts.
gaps.explanation: 'Go straight to number one' = reach the top position immediately.

gaps.sentence: The company is ___ serious financial difficulties.
The proposal was rejected ___ a single vote.
gaps.explanation: 'by a single vote / by two goals' — the margin takes 'by'.

gaps.sentence: The project is ___ way to completion ahead of schedule.
The bridge is at ___ open to traffic after three years of works.
The team is out of ___ after the long break.
gaps.explanation: 'Out of practice' = having lost skill through lack of use.

gaps.sentence: Everything was left ___ the care of the neighbours.
gaps.explanation: 'in the care of' = looked after by.

gaps.sentence: There is no harm ___ trying once more.
gaps.explanation: 'No harm in trying' = it costs nothing to try.'
